title: Cylindrical object
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, create a first loop by drawing a circle with a center at coordinates (0.0078, 0.0078) and a radius of 0.0078. Then, create a second loop by drawing another circle with the same center but a smaller radius of 0.0065. After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.0156 to the entire two-dimensional sketch to achieve the desired dimensions. Since the Euler angles and translation vector are already set to zero, no further transformation is needed. Finally, extrude the scaled two-dimensional sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to generate the three-dimensional model. This extrusion will create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object will be a length and width of 0.015625 units and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0078, 0.0078)

# Create the outer circle
sketch = sketch.circle(0.0078)

# Create the inner circle
sketch = sketch.circle(0.0065)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# The final model
r = cylinder

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · best of 8
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the center and radius of the circles
center = (0.0078, 0.0078)
radius_outer = 0.0078
radius_inner = 0.0065

# Create the outer circle
r = r.center(center[0], center[1]).circle(radius_outer)

# Create the inner circle
r = r.circle(radius_inner)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical object
r = r.extrude(0.75)

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0078, 0.0078)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0078)  # Draw the outer circle
    .circle(0.0065)  # Draw the inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

import cadquery as cq

# Outer radius and inner radius of the tube
outer_r = 0.0078
inner_r = 0.0050
length = 0.75

# Create the hollow tube along Z
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(outer_r)
    .circle(inner_r)
    .extrude(length)
)
